N1 grammar such as ～ともなく, ～ずにはいられない, ～をものともせず, ～んばかり is allowed where faithful. Classical forms only inside quoted speech when present in the original.
Use only vocabulary at or below N1. Literary modern prose is allowed. Classical forms only inside quoted speech when the original has them. No modern slang.
Each sentence is at most 70 characters, including punctuation. Split long sentences into several short sentences.
Keep every event in the same order. Do not add events, people, feelings or explanations.
Grammar examples are optional: use a construction only when its exact logical relation matches the original. Never introduce a negation, contrast, certainty or conjecture just to demonstrate grammar. Join related original propositions into longer connected sentences at advanced levels.

Write normal Japanese with no spaces between words.
